title: ActorReference
description: PILOT DEFINITION. Every SCS canonical contract references ActorReference but none defines it (TODO(actor-reference)). This is the shape the pilot records wherever a contract says ActorReference; it must be confirmed in a shared contract before admission.

actorId.description: Stable identifier of the person or service. Unique within the deployment.

actorType.description: Whether the actor is a person or an automated service.

roles.description: Roles held by the actor, e.g. COMPLIANCE_OFFICER. Capabilities decide which roles they accept.

organizationId.description: Organisation the actor acts for, if any.

authenticationMethod.description: How the actor was authenticated for this request. When OIDC replaces the pilot's static tokens, the shape of ActorReference does not change — only this value changes, from STATIC_TOKEN to OIDC.
